en.title: ProcureEase
en.subtitle: AI-Powered School Procurement Platform
en.description: Hong Kong school procurement platform with a 14-stage tender workflow, supplier portal, audit center, and AI-assisted spec and bid analysis.
en.features: 8 system roles, invite-only Supabase RBAC, PDF extraction, OpenRouter/OpenAI integration for tender analysis.
en.role: Sole full-stack lead — architecture, Supabase migrations & RLS, AI integration, Express API.
en.result: Alpha delivered September 2025; standardized procurement workflow for school administrators.

zh.title: ProcureEase
zh.subtitle: AI 學校採購平台

zh.features: 8 個系統角色、邀請制 Supabase RBAC、PDF 提取、OpenRouter/OpenAI 招標分析。

zh.result: 2025 年 9 月交付 Alpha；為學校管理員標準化採購流程。

en.title: XCB-SEN
en.subtitle: Special Educational Needs Care Platform
en.description: Multi-role SEN student care platform for Hong Kong schools — therapy records (PT/OT/ST), goals, skill ratings, contact book, and AI assistants.
en.features: 15 roles, 15 tables, 28 Supabase migrations, demo-tenant sandboxes, in-app notification center.
en.role: Architecture, full-stack development, Supabase RLS + triggers, Express AI server.
en.result: Comprehensive SEN workflow digitised with role-based access and AI-assisted reporting.

zh.title: XCB-SEN
zh.subtitle: 特殊教育需要照顧平台
zh.description: 香港學校多角色 SEN 學生照顧平台——治療記錄（PT/OT/ST）、目標、技能評分、聯絡簿及 AI 助手。
zh.features: 15 個角色、15 張表、28 個 Supabase migrations、demo 租戶沙盒、站內通知中心。

zh.result: 完整 SEN 工作流程數碼化，具角色權限控制及 AI 輔助報告。

en.title: RAG Chat
en.subtitle: Enterprise Knowledge Search
en.description: Enterprise AI chat over Google Drive / OneDrive document libraries — permission-scoped RAG tied to Drive share permissions per user email.
en.features: n8n + Qdrant vector search, Supabase auth & admin directory ACLs, async message polling.
en.role: React chat UI, Supabase permissions, n8n workflow design, Qdrant filter architecture.
en.result: Staff can query internal documents without accessing files outside their Drive permissions.

zh.title: RAG Chat
zh.subtitle: 企業知識搜尋
zh.description: 企業 AI 對話，覆蓋 Google Drive / OneDrive 文件庫——按用戶電郵對應 Drive 分享權限的 RAG 檢索。
zh.features: n8n + Qdrant 向量搜尋、Supabase 認證及目錄 ACL 管理、非同步訊息輪詢。
zh.role: React 對話 UI、Supabase 權限、n8n workflow 設計、Qdrant filter 架構。
zh.result: 員工可查詢內部文件，不會存取超出 Drive 權限的內容。

en.title: M365 Audit Tool
en.subtitle: SharePoint Audit Log Analytics
en.description: Microsoft 365 SharePoint audit log analysis — CSV import (50+ columns), search with 14 indexes, access-rights reports, and compliance analytics.
en.features: Express API + Supabase monorepo, Recharts dashboards, batch import pipeline.
en.role: Import pipeline, search UI, Express auth layer, analytics dashboards.
en.result: IT admins can search, analyse, and report on M365 audit activity at scale.

zh.title: M365 Audit Tool
zh.subtitle: SharePoint 審計日誌分析

en.title: Starfish ID

en.role: Solo full-stack dev + deployment + maintenance + internal coordination.
en.result: Actively used by the company and select clients, replacing paper business cards. Stable in production.
